description: lesson-architect evaluation cases. 'lesson' cases are real sample lessons produced by following the skill; 'fixture' cases are deliberately defective inputs the structural checker must reject. Structural results never establish teaching quality; the qualitative verdicts live in each example's review.md.
qualitative_checks: Every learning outcome is taught and assessed
Terminology and notation are introduced before use
Followable without filling missing conceptual steps

lessons.prompt: Write me a beginner lesson in Markdown on solving two-step linear equations like 3x + 5 = 20. I'm an adult who remembers arithmetic but never really understood algebra.

Create a Jupyter notebook lesson explaining why 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3 in Python, i.e. how floating-point numbers actually work and how to compare them safely. I'm comfortable writing basic Python but know nothing about how numbers are stored in a computer.

Teach me the ResNet paper — 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' (arXiv:1512.03385) — as a Markdown lesson. I know what a neural-network layer, a training loss, and gradient descent are, but I've never read a research paper and I don't know convolutional networks in detail.

Make me a beginner piano practice lesson in Markdown. I've never played. I have a 61-key keyboard at home and I want to be able to play my first simple melody with my right hand, steadily, by the end.
